name: azdo-argocd-tasks
description: Azure DevOps pipeline tasks for Argo CD

scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run typecheck && node scripts/build.mjs
scripts.package: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --output-path dist/
scripts.package:dev: npm run build && tfx extension create --manifest-globs vss-extension.json --overrides-file vss-extension.dev.json --output-path dist/
